baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالَ رَبِّ frames دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي, while لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا closes the temporal span.
baseline_models.mechanism: An audible report is directed upward to sovereign authority and describes a call meant to draw a whole people near across the complementary conditions of dark night and opened daylight.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the verse an audible report and frames the mission account.
Lordship and authority identify the addressee before whom the account is rendered.
Calling that draws near by speech supplies the mission's directional action.
A gathered people supplies the collective object rather than isolated hearers.
Night as darkness and the opposite of day supplies one pole of exhaustive time.
Day opening with light supplies the complementary pole that completes the span.

changed_reading.before: Noah simply states that he called his people continually.
changed_reading.after: Noah renders an audible mission account to sovereign authority: he kept drawing the whole collective near through the full alternation of darkness and daylight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The relational sequence رَبِّ ... دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي places the caller between nurturing lordship and his own people.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call is sustained formative care: under a Lord characterized by repair and completion, the speaker assumes responsibility for helping a people rise into an undertaking and remain guarded through every temporal condition.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative horizon of the address.
Drawing near through speech supplies the means of formative care.
Care, guardianship, and preservation recast the possessive people as an entrusted collective.
Resolve and rising to undertake an affair supply the response the call seeks to form.
Undertaking an affair by night makes the care active rather than merely durative.
Opened daylight extends the formative work into exposed daily life.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports repeated preaching to a population.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents round-the-clock pastoral formation: the caller tries to raise an entrusted people toward stable action under the Lord's completing care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The call is explicitly distributed between لَيْلًا, marked by darkness, and نَهَارًا, marked by opening light.
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal pair also supplies alternating visibility conditions. The same drawing speech persists when reception is concealed and when it is exposed, so continuity includes situational adaptability rather than duration alone.

activation_trace.role: Speech that calls people near is the invariant action across changing visibility.
Night's darkness supplies the concealed condition of the rhythm.
Day's opening light supplies the exposed condition of the rhythm.
Opening and widening give daylight a functional role as expanded communicative space.

changed_reading.before: Night and day are a conventional expression for frequency.
changed_reading.after: Night and day mark a repeated passage between concealed and exposed communicative conditions, with the call maintained through both.

context_deltas.mechanism: The continuous call is bounded by a mission sent in advance of harm: warning is meant to awaken caution and open protective forgiveness before a fixed term arrives. Exhaustive time is therefore urgent coverage of a closing opportunity, not timeless repetition.

activation_trace.role: The focus call draws the people near and remains the action revised by the context.
Night supplies one half of the focus verse's exhaustive temporal coverage.
Opened day completes the focus verse's exhaustive temporal coverage.
Sending and dispatch identify the call as an assigned mission rather than private initiative.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution gives the call its preventive purpose.
Precedence and approach supply the before-arrival window in which the call operates.
Covering sin and protecting its bearer from effects supplies the rescue offered by the warning.
A fixed temporal limit turns night-and-day persistence into work before closure.

structural_cues: 71:1 gives a before-harm commission; 71:3 specifies its imperatives; 71:4 contrasts delay for the people with a divine term that cannot be delayed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, warning, precedence, protective forgiveness, and a fixed term; I infer that continuous calling is preventive saturation of a closing window. A live alternative is that night and day only intensify frequency without encoding deadline strategy.

changed_reading.before: The caller works at all hours.
changed_reading.after: The caller fills every remaining temporal opening with preventive warning before an approaching, non-deferrable limit closes the chance of protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The call's near-drawing vector meets an engineered counter-vector: it increases flight, while hearers block reception, cover themselves, knot their resolve, and magnify themselves. Night-and-day persistence is measured against a self-sealing resistance system rather than mere inattention.

activation_trace.role: The focus call supplies the intended vector of drawing the people near.
The focus people remain the collective in which resistance is coordinated.
Increase and growth make resistance an accumulating effect rather than a static refusal.
The repeated near-drawing call is explicitly the input to the adverse feedback.
Flight and escape reverse the call's intended direction.
Protective covering is the offered outcome that their own coverings ironically refuse.
Listening and accepting what is heard identify the reception channel they deliberately obstruct.
A cover laid over something supplies the active self-concealment that seals reception.
Garment and covering make the resistance bodily and materially enacted.
Binding and knotting turn persistence in refusal into tightened closure.
Grandeur and pride supply the self-elevation that completes the defensive system.

structural_cues: 71:6 gives the paradoxical increase-to-flight result; 71:7 stacks bodily barriers, including the branchless finger cue, before persistence and pride.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit increase-to-flight relation and a sequence of blocked hearing, covering, binding, and pride; I infer a coordinated feedback system in which intensified address produces intensified closure. The alternative is a list of independent refusal gestures without a common mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Continuous calling demonstrates the speaker's diligence despite poor response.
changed_reading.after: Continuous calling presses against a counter-system that converts every near-drawing appeal into more distance and seals each route of reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pair night/day becomes one axis in a broader coverage matrix. The same call is then run through loud public declaration and hidden private communication, crossing temporal and social-visibility conditions rather than merely repeating one delivery style.

activation_trace.role: Dark night supplies the concealed temporal pole of the first axis.
Opened daylight supplies the exposed temporal pole of the first axis.
The same drawing call is held constant while its delivery mode changes.
Public declaration and raised voice supply an overt broadcast mode.
Making something manifest reinforces the public-facing side of the matrix.
Concealing something inwardly supplies a private or covert delivery mode.

structural_cues: ثُمَّ opens both 71:8 and 71:9, while 71:9 directly pairs declaration with secrecy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal opposition, sequential repetition, and overt/covert modes; I infer a two-axis strategy that varies access conditions. A live alternative is emphatic restatement with no deliberate matrix.

changed_reading.before: Night and day mean that the same appeal was frequent.
changed_reading.after: Night and day inaugurate systematic channel coverage: the appeal crosses time, public audibility, explicit declaration, and private concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch-distant material model links the call to priming and circulation. The focus call can evoke a retained trace that draws further flow, while the surrounding sequence moves from protective repair to sky-sending, abundant outpouring, connected increase, and rivers; even focus نَهَارًا carries a river-channel branch. The appeal becomes an attempted opening of a regenerative circuit.

activation_trace.role: A milk remnant that draws more milk supplies the exploratory image of the call as a primer for further flow.
Repair, nurture, and completion give the proposed circuit a restorative function.
A river cutting ground with flowing water gives the focus day-word a secondary channel image.
Protective covering of sin supplies the circuit's initial restorative release.
Nurturing completion ties the requested forgiveness to regenerative care.
Successive milk-flow imagery gives the sky's sending a sustained material cadence.
Abundant issuing from a source supplies the circuit's outpouring.
Connected increase that supports another supplies replenishment through the circuit.
Rivers cutting channels make the proposed flow spatially explicit in the context.

structural_cues: 71:10-12 sequences seeking forgiveness, sky-sending, abundant rain, connected provision, gardens, and rivers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies priming residue, nurture, outpouring, connected increase, and river channels; I infer that the call attempts to initiate a regenerative circuit. The materially live alternative is that these are promised consequences listed after the call, with no hydraulic structure inside 71:5 itself.

changed_reading.before: Calling is only verbal exhortation conducted continuously.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the continuous appeal acts like priming a blocked channel so protective and life-giving increase can begin to circulate through the people.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night and day expand from the caller's schedule into an ordered pedagogic environment. Created stages and superposed layers culminate in differentiated lunar light and a solar lamp, so his temporal persistence tracks the very alternation he asks the people to notice.

activation_trace.role: Night's darkness anchors one observable phase of the focus alternation.
Day opening in light anchors the other observable phase.
Measuring and proportioning supply ordered formation rather than random succession.
Successive stages make patterned alternation a principle of created development.
Layers arranged over one another supply a structured cosmic setting.
The moon and its celestial light concretize the nocturnal phase.
Illumination gives night a differentiated light rather than simple absence.
The sun supplies the visible source governing the daylight phase.
A shining lamp makes daylight an active instrument in the ordered cycle.

structural_cues: 71:15 asks the audience to see the layered heavens; 71:16 differentiates the moon's light from the sun's lamp.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stages, layers, moonlight, and solar lamp; I infer that the caller's night/day practice embodies the ordered alternation used as evidence. The alternative is that the creation argument is independent of his schedule.

changed_reading.before: Night and day quantify how long Noah spoke.
changed_reading.after: His speaking inhabits and reenacts an ordered cosmic alternation, turning persistence itself into part of the pedagogy of signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The formative baseline becomes ecological and spatial. People are described through growth from earth, return and emergence; the earth is spread so broad routes can be penetrated. The call seeks both cultivation of the people and passageways by which they can rise into another course.

activation_trace.role: Drawing near by speech anchors cultivation and route-opening in the focus action.
Rising with resolve supplies the human movement the formative call seeks.
Opening and widening supply a focus-side image for making passage possible.
Human growth and upbringing make the people cultivable rather than fixed.
Soft fertile earth supplies the substrate from which that human growth proceeds.
Return after departure places human formation within a reversible cycle.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence as the cycle's forward motion.
Spreading and extension make traversable space available.
Penetrating along a route supplies purposeful passage through that space.
An extended traversable road gives the call a directional option for its people.
A broad opened pass supplies room for collective movement rather than confinement.

structural_cues: 71:17-20 moves from human growth out of earth, through return and emergence, to an earth spread for traversing broad paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human growth, cyclic emergence, spread ground, and broad traversable routes; I infer that the near-drawing call cultivates capacity and opens a course for the people. The alternative is that the creation sequence only demonstrates divine power and does not model the call's operation.

changed_reading.before: Sustained calling is formative care expressed in speech.
changed_reading.after: Sustained calling becomes cultivation and path-making: it works on a growable people and tries to open broad routes for their rising.

context_deltas.mechanism: قَوْمِي is no longer a neutral audience label but a contested field of allegiance. The caller tries to gather and raise the people, while they disobey him and enter a following-chain organized by wealth, offspring, magnified schemes, and numerical spread; that rival organization increases loss and misdirection.

activation_trace.role: The near-drawing call anchors the attempted reorganization of allegiance.
The people as a collective are the social field being organized.
Opposition and facing off expose latent contest inside the designation of the people.
Departure from obedience marks rejection of the caller's organizing claim.
Allegiance and succession identify a rival chain that the people join.
Increase and growth describe the rival chain's worsening output.
Possession and abundance of wealth supply one source of rival social leverage.
Offspring and lineage supply another durable source of leverage and continuity.
General diminution names the actual product of apparent increase.
The magnitude of an affair supplies scale to the rival scheme.
Deviation from guidance gives the rival network its directional effect.
Numerical growth shows that misdirection propagates collectively.

structural_cues: 71:21 contrasts disobeying Noah with following a wealth-and-offspring figure; 71:22-24 adds plotted magnitude, named inherited loyalties, and many people misled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disobedience, following, wealth, lineage, magnified plotting, and many misled; I infer a rival social network competing to constitute the qawm. The alternative is a set of individual moral failures without network structure.

changed_reading.before: My people names the audience toward whom Noah feels responsibility.
changed_reading.after: My people names a disputed collective: his continuous call competes with wealth, lineage, inherited loyalties, and followership for the power to organize them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening قَالَ رَبِّ becomes the first deposition in a repeated address to authority. Later reports state disobedience and culminate in a petition after transgression, drowning, entry, and failed aid; the final prayer contrasts leaving no resistant resident with secure entry into the caller's house. The night-and-day claim functions as evidence of exhausted outreach before judgment and sorting.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the focus verse as a formal report.
Lordship and authority supply the addressee capable of adjudicating the report.
Night contributes one evidentiary half of the claimed exhaustive effort.
Day contributes the complementary half of the claimed exhaustive effort.
A second uttered report resumes the address with the people's disobedience.
Repeated appeal to sovereign authority links the later report to the focus address.
Sin and offense supply the stated basis for the resulting judgment.
Drowning supplies the realized reversal after the warning period.
Entry into an interior supplies the adverse side of the later entry contrast.
Aid and vindication mark the support they fail to find after rejecting the call.
Leaving something in place supplies the object of the final negative petition.
Covering the truth identifies the resistant class named in that petition.
A resident or house-affiliated person gives the petition its exhaustive social scope.
Entry into an interior now supplies the protected side of the spatial contrast.
Shelter and dwelling define the protected interior opened to responsive entrants.
Security and settled trust characterize those included in the protective prayer.
Destruction, invalidation, and breaking close the petition's adverse side.

structural_cues: قَالَ ... رَبِّ recurs at 71:21 and 71:26; 71:25 narrates consequence, and 71:28 ends with a sharply divided prayer for protected entrants and destruction of wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated reports to the Lord, stated fault, realized consequence, failed aid, and a final sorting petition; I infer a deposition-like trajectory in which 71:5 records exhausted outreach as evidence. A live alternative is lament and supplication without forensic force.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a retrospective complaint about long effort.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the opening evidentiary statement in a repeated address to authority: exhaustive outreach is placed on record before consequence and the final boundary between protected entry and destruction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because نَهَارًا ordinarily contributes daylight, not rebuke. It remains anchored through the focus root's harsh-speech branch and gains contextual support from the overt/covert delivery contrast and hardened resistance. Downstream prose should present it only as a tonal branch echo, never as a replacement lexical translation of نَهَارًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes night with a ن ه ر word whose inventory includes both opened daylight and harsh verbal rebuke.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech anchors the proposed tonal variation in the actual focus action.
Night's darkness supplies the quieter or concealed pole of the exploratory contrast.
Harsh verbal rebuke supplies a branch echo of increased daytime speech pressure.
Raised public speech makes an overt, forceful register contextually available.
Hidden communication supplies the contrasting quiet register.

changed_reading.before: Night and day vary only the time of calling.
changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, the pair may also carry a tonal swing from concealed entreaty to openly pressurized or rebuking speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل target of the split ق و ل mapping, so it cannot define the direct sense of قَالَ. It remains anchored to the focus citation and coheres with the people's rising, connected support, and later path traversal. Downstream prose should label it a secondary kinetic image of prophetic labor, not morphology or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus قَالَ has a packet-authorized non-dominant mapped branch of carrying, lifting, and rising beside قَوْمِي.

activation_trace.role: Carrying, lifting, and rising supply a kinetic undertone to the introductory speech.
Rising with resolve makes the people the burden the speech tries to lift into action.
Connected support reinforces the image of sustained bearing rather than a single utterance.
Penetrating a path supplies the direction toward which the burden-bearing speech works.

changed_reading.after: As a non-dominant branch echo, the report also images speech labor that bears and tries to lift a people toward movement through a path.

strongest_changes: Night-and-day calling became preventive saturation of a mission window bounded by an approaching fixed term.
The immediate sequel recast persistence as pressure against a self-sealing feedback system that turns near-drawing speech into flight.
Public, declared, and secret calls transformed the temporal pair into a matrix of delivery conditions.
The possessive 'my people' became a contested social field organized by competing chains of care, wealth, lineage, and followership.
Rain, growth, cosmic alternation, and broad paths activated regenerative and route-making models without displacing the verbal anchor.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse contains unusually productive hinges: a complete night/day polarity, a call whose branches include drawing and priming, a people-root that can gather or rise, and split mappings for both speech and lordship. Later context repeatedly crosses those hinges with delivery modes, material circulation, created cycles, social counter-allegiance, and renewed reports to the Lord.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydraulic and cultivation mechanisms may be coherent contextual analogies rather than intended internal mechanics of 71:5.
The deposition model depends on a reader-supplied forensic direction; lamentative prayer remains live.
The non-dominant ق ل ل activation and the rebuke branch of ن ه ر should remain explicitly secondary echoes, not lexical claims.
